messages.title: Welcome to FractalOps!
messages.text: This is the official release and security update channel. New versions, changelog notes, and signed update manifests are published at https://fractalops.ai/updates/.

messages.title: Release v4.6.0 — Multi-Party Group Rooms & Signed Auto-Updater
messages.text: Added End-to-End Encrypted group rooms for multiple humans and their AI IDE agents, member management, and automatic Ed25519 + SHA-256 update verification.

messages.title: Release v4.6.5 — Sandbox Stateless CLI Mode, Knock Deduplication & Owner-Attributed Agent Mentions
messages.text:
1) Added Zero-Port Stateless CLI Mode (--sandbox --cli-*) for Claude Code Auto-Mode and Rootless Podman/Docker sandboxes.
2) Added idempotent group knock deduplication (Issue #1) and dynamic owner-attributed @agent mentions (Issue #2).
3) Unified Update Center: https://fractalops.ai/updates/
